w_p00_0_0: The Bitcoin White Paper by "Satoshi Nakamoto" turns ten years old this month. Today, arguments rage about manic speculation, "dark web" sales, crpytocurrency's carbon footprint, and warring technical standards. But before Bitcoin became a popular phenomenon, it was an idea―a concept greater than any ticker symbol: electronic cash for the entire world. This idea still exists, and it's a fascinating one that too few understand. I hope this helps.
